name: Writable anonymous mapping below exclusive bound 0x10000
required_postconditions: a writable anonymous mapping succeeds entirely below exclusive bound 0x10000

failure_sink.description: every page-aligned placement below the measured bound is refused even though the same call succeeds at the bound

extraction_limitations: Linux-only executable oracle. The runner derives address_max from this run's measured min_map_address and passes the identical value to the case.
x_groundtruth: The case first maps and touches a positive control exactly at the measured floor, then boundedly enumerates every page-aligned mapping start below the exclusive bound with MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE. Only policy refusals for every candidate produce below-bound-unavailable.
